interpretations: For each funding source represented by matched spatial records, count all its spatial records and average the nonmissing `boxy / boxz` ratios. Keep sources whose count exceeds the average count across those sources. Return the unweighted average of the kept source averages, the sum of their counts, and their average count excess
Use the same calculation, but average the ratios of all spatial records in the kept sources together, weighting sources by their number of nonmissing ratios
Count only spatial records with nonmissing `boxy` and `boxz` when calculating each source’s count, the cross-source average count, and the count excess

Include every funding source in `projects` when calculating the cross-source average count, assigning zero to sources with no matched spatial records; calculate the returned values from sources that pass the count threshold
Use the same source grouping and record counts as the first interpretation, but exclude records with `boxz = 0` from the ratio averages as well as records with missing ratio inputs
For each funding source, calculate the ratio of its average nonmissing `boxy` to its average nonmissing `boxz`, then apply the first interpretation’s count threshold and final aggregation
queries:
WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         COUNT(*) AS record_count,
         AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scanspatial AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
count_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM source_stats
)
SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_source_ratio,
       SUM(ss.record_count) AS total_records,
       AVG(ss.record_count - ca.avg_count) AS avg_count_excess
FROM source_stats AS ss
CROSS JOIN count_average AS ca
WHERE ss.record_count > ca.avg_count

WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    COUNT(s.domainregistry) AS spatial_record_count
  FROM projects AS p
  LEFT JOIN scanspatial AS s
    ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
   AND s.boxy IS NOT NULL
   AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT
  funding_source,
  spatial_record_count,
  AVG(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS average_count,
  spatial_record_count - AVG(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS count_excess
FROM source_counts;
